rules.question: Are N+1 database queries absent?
rules.applies_if: Using ORMs or DB queries inside loops

rules.question: Do collection fetches enforce size limits?
rules.applies_if: DB queries or network calls fetching collections

rules.question: Are operations free from unbounded loops?
rules.applies_if: While/for loops driven by external input or dynamic conditions

rules.question: Is algorithmic complexity proportionate to dataset size?
rules.applies_if: Processing data collections

rules.question: Is allocation of large objects avoided in hot paths?
rules.applies_if: High-throughput routes or frequent execution paths

rules.question: Is synchronous I/O avoided on event loops or critical threads?
rules.applies_if: Node.js, async/await, or UI main thread environments

rules.question: Are external calls batched where appropriate?
rules.applies_if: Repeated DB or third-party service invocations

rules.question: Are connections, pools, and thread counts bounded?
rules.applies_if: Configuring HTTP clients, DB pools, or worker threads

rules.question: Are acquired resources guaranteed to be released?
rules.applies_if: Allocating file descriptors, sockets, connections

rules.question: Are memory leaks absent?
rules.applies_if: Event listeners, in-memory caches, or global references

rules.question: Do payload structures exclude unnecessary data?
rules.applies_if: HTTP responses or network messages

rules.question: Is lazy loading used where it prevents unnecessary work?
rules.applies_if: Initializing heavy modules or optional resources

rules.question: Is code splitting used to reduce initial bundle sizes?
rules.applies_if: Frontend applications / Web bundlers

rules.question: Are unnecessary UI re-renders avoided?
rules.applies_if: UI components (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, etc.)

rules.question: Do cache keys properly uniquely identify data?
rules.applies_if: Caching layer usage

rules.question: Do caches enforce correct TTL or invalidation mechanisms?
rules.applies_if: Caching layer usage

rules.question: Do caches refrain from mixing multi-tenant or user-private data?
rules.applies_if: Caching multi-tenant or user-private data

rules.question: Are caches free from cache stampede risks?
rules.applies_if: High-concurrency cache keys with expensive compute times

rules.question: Is polling strictly bounded and necessary?
rules.applies_if: Client or server polling logic

rules.question: Does implementation comply with defined latency budgets?
rules.applies_if: Defined SLA or SLO latency constraints

rules.question: Is computational effort proportionate to produced value?
rules.applies_if: Data processing and intensive computations

rules.question: Does implementation refrain from introducing avoidable energy consumption?
rules.applies_if: Background jobs, frequent polling, or busy waiting
